_comment: ICAO Carbon Emissions Calculator + ACI Carbon Accreditation + IPCC factors. All public sources.

flight._comment: Per-passenger-km emission factors from ICAO Carbon Calculator (2024). Falls back to short_haul.

apu._comment: ICAO Doc 9889 / EEDB. Default narrow-body APU burn ~3.0 kg CO2/min (~1.0 kg fuel × 3.16 EI).

terminal._comment: ACI energy benchmark + EU grid intensity (EEA 2023, ~233 g CO2/kWh).

ground_vehicle._comment: Ground service equipment (tugs, belt loaders) per turnaround. ICAO Annex 16 reference.

scenario._comment: Reduction factors when toggled in net-zero builder.
